classification.difficultyReason: Identify two perpendicular triangles in differently oriented prisms, retain an exact intermediate diagonal and calculate a rounded space diagonal, with progressively reduced drawing scaffolds.

content.prompt: For each of these rectangular prisms, first find $BE$, leaving your answer in exact form, then find $BH$, rounded to 2 decimal places. Draw and label the right-angled triangles you are using.

spec.description: Wide rectangular prism with labelled vertices, dimensions and the two highlighted right triangles. Ordinary source-blue edges become black; red hidden-edge distinctions and meaningful triangle fills are retained in the standard palette.
spec.mathematics: Front face A B C D; rear face E F G H. AB=5, BF=3, FG=2. BE is a face diagonal and BH is a space diagonal. Hidden edges AE, EF and EH are dashed.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied geometry and construction lines remain visible; no calculated lengths.

spec.description: Two labelled right-triangle scaffolds side by side, with no numerical side lengths. Ordinary source-blue strokes become black.
spec.mathematics: Triangle EAB is right-angled at A; triangle HEB is right-angled at E.
spec.answerVisibility: Vertex labels and right-angle marks are permanent givens; students supply lengths.

answer.worked:
In right-angled triangle $EAB$, $AE=3$ and $AB=5$.
$$\begin{aligned}BE^2&=3^2+5^2\\BE&=\sqrt{34}\end{aligned}$$
In right-angled triangle $HEB$, $HE=2$.
$$\begin{aligned}BH^2&=2^2+(\sqrt{34})^2\\BH^2&=38\\BH&=\sqrt{38}\\BH&\approx6.16\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Completed pair of supplied right triangles.
spec.mathematics: EAB has legs 3 and 5 and hypotenuse sqrt(34); HEB has legs 2 and sqrt(34) and hypotenuse sqrt(38).
